killedBy: createHud application transition contract reports the versus setup pane opening and closing exactly once per transition (issue #785)
createHud application transition contract closes the versus setup pane when a surface change takes it away (issue #785)
createRouteHost: Versus Setup reads the controllers already connected (issue #785) holds its hotplug listeners for exactly as long as the pane is up
why: The pane's ONE close point for Back and for a surface change alike: `back()` re-enters the origin through `setState`, so this call is what fires the close on Back too. A second call in `closeVersusPane` was tried and its mutation SURVIVED with 0 failures, so it was deleted rather than kept untested. Without this one, a match started from the pane (Settings' leak before issue #227) and an ordinary Back both leave route-ui's hotplug listeners on the page.
